session_event_uq.name: session_event_uq
session_event_uq.where: "session"."calendar_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."deleted_at" IS NULL

moodle_deadline_source_chk.name: moodle_deadline_source_chk
moodle_deadline_source_chk.value: ("moodle_deadline"."source" = 'aufgabe' AND "moodle_deadline"."moodle_assignment_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("moodle_deadline"."source" = 'termin' AND "moodle_deadline"."moodle_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

search_chunk_parent_chk.name: search_chunk_parent_chk
search_chunk_parent_chk.value:
("search_chunk"."source_kind" = 'slide' AND "search_chunk"."deck_id" IS NOT NULL AND "search_chunk"."session_id" IS NULL AND "search_chunk"."part" = 0
            AND "search_chunk"."slide_index" IS NOT NULL AND "search_chunk"."slide_index" >= 1 AND "search_chunk"."t_ms" IS NULL AND "search_chunk"."t_end_ms" IS NULL)
        OR ("search_chunk"."source_kind" = 'transcript' AND "search_chunk"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "search_chunk"."deck_id" IS NULL
            AND "search_chunk"."source_id" = "search_chunk"."session_id" AND "search_chunk"."slide_index" IS NULL AND "search_chunk"."title" IS NULL
            AND "search_chunk"."t_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "search_chunk"."t_ms" >= 0 AND "search_chunk"."t_end_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "search_chunk"."t_end_ms" >= "search_chunk"."t_ms")

concept_one_liner_chk.name: concept_one_liner_chk
concept_one_liner_chk.value: "concept"."one_liner" IS NULL OR char_length("concept"."one_liner") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

concept_merged_chk.name: concept_merged_chk
concept_merged_chk.value: ("concept"."status" = 'zusammengefuehrt') = ("concept"."merged_into" IS NOT NULL) AND "concept"."merged_into" IS DISTINCT FROM "concept"."id"

concept_proposal_chk.name: concept_proposal_chk
concept_proposal_chk.value: ("concept"."status" <> 'vorschlag' OR "concept"."proposal_session_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("concept"."status" <> 'aktiv' OR "concept"."proposal_session_id" IS NULL)

concept_relation_why_chk.name: concept_relation_why_chk
concept_relation_why_chk.value: "concept_relation"."why" IS NULL OR char_length("concept_relation"."why") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

evidence_times_chk.name: evidence_times_chk
evidence_times_chk.value:
("evidence"."kind" = 'transcript' AND "evidence"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence"."ref_id" = "evidence"."session_id"
            AND "evidence"."t_start_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence"."t_start_ms" >= 0 AND "evidence"."t_end_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence"."t_end_ms" >= "evidence"."t_start_ms")
        OR ("evidence"."kind" <> 'transcript' AND "evidence"."t_start_ms" IS NULL AND "evidence"."t_end_ms" IS NULL)

evidence_quote_chk.name: evidence_quote_chk
evidence_quote_chk.value: "evidence"."quote" IS NULL OR char_length("evidence"."quote") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

inbox_item_refs_chk.name: inbox_item_refs_chk
inbox_item_refs_chk.value:
("inbox_item"."kind" = 'concept_new' AND "inbox_item"."concept_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_item"."target_concept_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."relation_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."card_concept_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("inbox_item"."kind" = 'concept_merge' AND "inbox_item"."concept_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_item"."target_concept_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_item"."relation_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."card_concept_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("inbox_item"."kind" = 'relation' AND "inbox_item"."relation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_item"."concept_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."target_concept_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."card_concept_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("inbox_item"."kind" = 'card_batch' AND "inbox_item"."card_concept_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_item"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_item"."concept_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."target_concept_id" IS NULL AND "inbox_item"."relation_id" IS NULL)

inbox_item_decided_chk.name: inbox_item_decided_chk
inbox_item_decided_chk.value: ("inbox_item"."status" = 'offen') = ("inbox_item"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("inbox_item"."status" <> 'offen' OR "inbox_item"."decision" IS NULL)

card_state_numbers_chk.name: card_state_numbers_chk
card_state_numbers_chk.value:
"card_state"."stability" >= 0 AND "card_state"."difficulty" >= 0 AND "card_state"."elapsed_days" >= 0 AND "card_state"."scheduled_days" >= 0
        AND "card_state"."learning_steps" >= 0 AND "card_state"."reps" >= 0 AND "card_state"."lapses" >= 0
